description: The privileged control window: application commands and approved-link opening on top of core defaults. The dialog plugin is deliberately NOT granted — file pickers run in Rust (src/dialogs.rs) so no filesystem path is ever chosen by, or passed through, JavaScript (H5, spec §50.7). `core:window:allow-set-fullscreen` is deliberately NOT granted either: presentation is borderless (windows/present.rs), and the renderer calling OS fullscreen directly is what put a white bar over the opening of every take — withholding the permission is what stops that path being reintroduced by accident. `opener:default` is deliberately NOT granted either: it lets the webview open ANY url, and the one place the app needs it is a model licence link. That goes through `open_model_licence`, which checks the url against the licence urls the speech-model catalogue itself declares — so the webview can open exactly those and nothing else. Rust's own `reveal_item_in_dir` calls need no capability: capabilities gate the JavaScript→plugin path, and those run in Rust.
